summary: Travere Therapeutics filed an 8-K on June 1, 2026, reporting an entry into a license and collaboration agreement with Everest Medicines. The agreement grants Travere exclusive rights to develop and commercialize Everest's BTK inhibitor, civorebrutinib, outside of China and certain Asian countries. Financial terms such as upfront payment, milestones, or royalties were not disclosed. The filing is a material definitive agreement under Item 1.01, containing no merger, tender, or governance change. Watch for future disclosures on financial terms and regulatory milestones.
